validation.rule: For each retained playable-static XModel, compare the retained LOD0 material-slot sequence to the exact material name referenced by every primitive emitted by OAT in <xmodel>_lod0.glb, in primitive order. OAT material-table entries not referenced by LOD0 primitives are ignored as higher-LOD/global-handle baggage.

geometryAssemblyContract.implication: LOD0 mesh primitives can be flattened into one reusable per-XModel mesh definition without discarding a mesh-node local transform. Skeletal helper nodes/skins are not required for static bind-pose placement geometry.
geometryAssemblyContract.unitAndBasisRuleToValidate: OAT XModel vertices are emitted in game linear units with game Z-up converted to glTF Y-up. GfxWorld placement matrices must receive the equivalent basis conjugation and 0.0254 meter conversion before final scene acceptance.

proofBoundary: This establishes exact retail identity and LOD0 surface/material correspondence for the 297 static mesh sources. It does not yet promote a world placement transform; placements remain gated on the independent GfxWorld static-placement dump.
